normalization: teacher proprio scales retained; no running observation normalization
actions: 12 leg position residuals, then 4 wheel velocity commands; teacher scaling retained
previous_action: previous issued action, before actuator delay
effective_variance: height + correlated height + relative pose + roll/pitch + cell-age growth
map_state: rolling gravity/yaw grid; observed cells retain individual capture timestamps
history: past noisy proprio only; oldest to newest; zero padded on reset; current proprio first
